tasks.task: List every source tool, object and join key

items.when: At the start of a warehouse project, before any sync tool is chosen or model written
When two tools hold the same customer or order, to set which tool owns each field
When source columns need a column-by-column map to the target with rules and gaps

tasks.task: Write a pipeline spec from the firm's tools to one warehouse

items.when: When shop, payments, CRM, ads and bookings must land in one database on a schedule
When you want a second design with raw, cleaned and report layers to set against yours
When the spec is agreed and a working pipeline with checks and a schedule is needed
When the design only covers the happy path, to plan for late, failed and repeated loads
Before full loads, to prove the whole path on a tiny sample and see the cost

tasks.task: Set up a firm's first warehouse

items.when: When a firm wants its tools' data in one place because reports disagree or take too long
When the database is not chosen, to pick one and outline schema, indexes and migration
When the warehouse is Snowflake and its SQL and loading rules must be followed
When the warehouse is Postgres and needs the right types, keys and indexes

tasks.task: Design the reporting schema

items.when: When each mart table needs a stated grain and a clear path from staging
When you need a clean schema with keys and query advice for the reports asked for
Before the marts, to fix how each reported metric is worked out
When the tables and links should be drawn as a diagram the client can read

tasks.task: Write layered models with tests

items.when: When staging, intermediate and mart models are needed in the client's SQL dialect
When a raw table has landed and needs a clean staging model with sources and tests
When the models live in a repo and should be written, run and tested in place
When a model grows large, to list the cases and change it in small tested steps
Before a model goes live, to find wrong-result risks, slow spots and safer rewrites
Before merge, for a review of bugs, tests and clarity ranked by how serious each is

tasks.task: Decide and write the tests for a model

items.when: Before writing or changing a model, to decide its tests and which failures block reports
When you do not know the data's faults yet, to find them and the rules that catch them
When tests need a made-up file with bad rows to prove each one fires
When staging needs realistic, repeatable data loaded into its tables

tasks.task: Write the run book and alert rules for a pipeline

items.when: When each source needs freshness and completeness promises and alerts with an owner
When one failure needs steps anyone can follow under pressure
When nobody has said how fresh is fresh enough, to set targets and an error budget
When row counts and totals need baselines and quiet periods so alerts stay few
When run books exist, to find missing owners, stale pages and gaps

tasks.task: Respond to a failed or late load

items.when: When an alert fires or someone reports a number that looks wrong
When you have the error or log and need the cause and a fix that works
When a job ran twice or not at all, to read the schedule and find silent mistakes
After the fix, to write a blameless record with timeline, causes and actions
When the incident should change the run book and leave tracked prevention actions

tasks.task: Check a re-run or backfill is safe before running it

items.when: When a load failed, ran late or ran twice and someone wants to re-run or backfill
When the pipeline is Python on BigQuery, to find repeat-run risks and costly queries
When the safe steps should be written into the run book for next time

tasks.task: Trace a report number back to the source and fix the gap

items.when: When a report number does not match the source tool and must be fixed for good
When two reports differ, to find the step where their counts split
When one difference must be traced to the entries on both sides
When a model's SQL must be read line by line for what it counts and drops
When two SQL Server tables should match, to list schema and row differences

tasks.task: Document tables, columns and lineage

items.when: When a table needs a plain entry with column meanings, sources and who may use it
When you need what reads a table or view and what sits downstream of it
When the path from raw table to report should be drawn as a diagram
When the pipeline code needs a README and usage notes that match what it does

tasks.task: Set warehouse spend guardrails

items.when: Before people, jobs or an AI tool get query access, or after a surprise bill
When queries from analysts or AI tools must stay read-only and safe on joins and privacy
When someone needs answers from Postgres through a read-only path with write protection
Each month, to see what grew on the bill, the waste behind it and caps to add

tasks.task: Release a pipeline change safely

items.when: For any change to a source, model, test or schedule that reaches production
Before changing a table or view, to list what depends on it
When the change alters a schema and needs a versioned step that can roll back
When the release needs its checks, a rollback plan and a sign it worked
Before release, for a read-only report of migration, config and order risks
When you want a go or no-go with version, changelog and a live check

tasks.task: Write SQL queries from a schema

items.when: When the need can be said in plain words and the database type is known
When the query runs on Snowflake and should follow its good practice
Before a query feeds a report, to find wrong-result risks and slow spots

tasks.task: Speed up a slow query or model

items.when: When one query is slow and needs the cause found and a faster version
When Postgres is slow across several queries and needs indexes and settings ranked
When people guess at the slow part, to follow the real run and measure first

tasks.task: Build an extract for a tool with no ready connector

items.when: When a source has an API but no sync tool, to get code with sign-in, retries and errors
When the source pushes events, to receive them with signature checks and safe repeats
When the source is Shopify and you need queries with paging and rate limits handled
When the source drops CSV, Excel, JSON or Parquet files that must be read correctly

tasks.task: Schedule jobs and run tests on every change

items.when: When a schedule is written, to see its next run times and catch silent mistakes
When model tests should run on every change before anything ships
When a CI run fails and you need the cause from the log and a fix

tasks.task: Check loaded data quality on a regular rhythm

items.when: When blanks, duplicates, broken links and stale data need a regular score per table
When ad and sales data in BigQuery must be checked before anyone reports on it
Each month, to catch broken tracking and double counts before they reach the warehouse

tasks.task: Plan personal data handling, access and secrets

items.when: When you need a map of where personal data lives and deletion that reaches every table
When pipeline keys and passwords need a safe plan to store, read and rotate
When shared queries may expose personal columns, to check privacy before access is given

tasks.task: Plan backups and rehearse a restore

items.when: When nobody has said how much data loss is acceptable or how a restore would run
When backups exist but no restore has been tested, to plan a safe rehearsal

tasks.task: Move data from an old database or tool to a new one

items.when: When data moves between tools and needs field maps, checks and a rollback path
When every old column needs a new home, a rule and a decision on gaps
After the move, when old and new SQL Server tables must be proved to match

tasks.task: Land product and web analytics events in the warehouse

items.when: When events are not yet defined, to set the event list and naming rules first
When the GA4 export is in BigQuery and must give sessions, channels and sign-ups

tasks.task: Write a technical design document or decision record

items.when: When a build needs an architecture choice with diagrams and trade-offs
When a design choice is made, to record why and what was passed over
When the design is drafted, to test it against layers, quality checks and failure plans

always.when: Before any build, when the request does not say which reports the data must feed
Before any change ships, to name what it could break outside its own diff
Before a spec or run book is handed over, to catch typos and terms used two ways

helpers.when: When the job is deep database work: indexes, replication, tuning or a hard schema migration
When the pipeline needs servers, containers, CI or cloud set-up beyond the data work
When the marts are ready and someone must define metrics and build the dashboards
When the firm needs a data dictionary, weekly quality checks or a duplicate clean-up
When a source needs a custom API client or the app itself must emit new data
When a small firm is better served by a no-code sync than by a warehouse

gaps: No library item writes dbt models, sources, tests, snapshots or contracts; only the kit covers dbt
No library item writes an Airflow or Dagster DAG, or plans job order, retries and dependencies for data loads
No library item compares sync tools or picks a load method (full, incremental or change capture) per source
No library item designs a star schema, a date table or history tables for values that change over time
No library item sets warehouse cost controls such as quotas, partitioning rules and per-user limits
No library item watches pipeline freshness and row counts; the monitoring items are for web services
No library item plans a safe backfill or proves a job can run twice without double counting
No library item draws a lineage map from a report number back to the raw table
No library item compares BigQuery, Snowflake and Postgres for a small firm's first warehouse
No library item syncs warehouse data back into a CRM or email tool
